meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步骤任务的计划、发现与进度落到磁盘文件,让 AI 助手跨会话接着干。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多,需要 AI 助手记住上下文并在中断后继续。
copy.tagline_en: Keep task plans, findings and progress on disk so an agent resumes long multi-step work.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your task needs many steps and the agent must remember context across sessions.

howto.what: Claude 会把任务计划、研究发现和进展写进项目里的 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件,每完成一阶段就更新状态并记录错误;即使上下文丢失或执行过 /clear,也能从这些磁盘文件读回继续。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆解或整理多步骤项目、研究任务,或预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时启动;在 /clear 之后也能自动从计划文件恢复会话。

say.text: 帮我拆解这个多步骤任务,先写 task_plan.md
say.note: Claude 会建计划文件并分阶段推进

say.text: 把这次查到的关键发现记到 findings.md
我们上次做到哪了?跑一下 session-catchup
say.note: 读取本项目本地会话记录做对账

howto.what_en: Claude keeps task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md in your project as on-disk working memory: it updates them after each phase and logs errors, so work survives context loss or /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan, break down or organize a multi-step project or research task, or any work needing 5+ tool calls; it can also recover the session after /clear.

say_en.text: Break this multi-step task down and write task_plan.md first
say_en.note: Creates the plan file, then works phase by phase

say_en.text: Save the key findings from this research into findings.md
say_en.note: Findings get written to disk right away

say_en.text: Where did we leave off? Run session-catchup
say_en.note: Reads local session records to check status
